title: The firm now describes itself as five connected operating units built around unproven hypotheses
summary: About and Native Alpha were rewritten to say the firm is organized around what it is not yet sure is true, and that each line of work ends in a decision.
text: Most companies organize around what they already know how to sell. Intellectual Frontiers starts from an observation and asks what the firm might know, see, control or be unusually capable of doing that matters to somebody else. The Native Alpha page walks through finding and testing a hypothesis, gathering evidence across the five units, and deciding to continue, change, back, build or stop.
